event: US jobless claims today 15:30 SAST; US jobs report Fri 15:30 SAST

bullets.title: Holding gains
bullets.text: Gold is near 4,128, keeping most of Wednesday's 3%+ jump, but it has not broken 4,146 yet.

bullets.title: Dollar weak
bullets.text: DXY is near 101.3, a one-month low after Democrats won Congress. A weaker dollar helps gold.

bullets.title: Headwind
bullets.text: Markets still price roughly 70-80% odds of a Fed hike on 9 Dec (sources differ). That caps rallies.

bullets.title: Oil drop
bullets.text: Oil fell about 8-9% on US-Iran peace hopes, which cools inflation fears.

bullets.title: Big buyers
bullets.text: Central banks bought 321 t in Q3 (+42% y/y), and gold ETFs hold a record amount.

bullets.title: BoE today
bullets.text: The Bank of England decides at 14:00 SAST; a hike to 4.00% was expected (result not checked, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Data next
bullets.text: US jobless claims at 15:30 SAST today, then Friday's jobs report: strong numbers lift the dollar and can pull gold toward 4,000.
